verdict.rationale: Publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a SaaS scheduling product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt help index and the auth-gated MCP endpoint are adjacent capabilities belonging to other stories, not a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
